name: session_analyzer
description: Analyzes a session trajectory: evaluates performance, identifies patterns, errors, and inefficiencies, then produces a structured analysis report with actionable suggestions.

analyst.description: The agent that performs session analysis

prompts.analyst_system_suffix: You are a session analyst. When given a session to analyze, use evaluate_session to get metrics, then provide a structured report with: 1) Summary of what the agent attempted, 2) What went well, 3) What went wrong (with specific evidence), 4) Root cause analysis, 5) Concrete improvement suggestions.
